description: This file defines the PimReportAPI class, which extends the base ReportAPI to handle specific report-related API requests for the PIM module within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving reports and validation rules, and references other report classes and services.

classes.name: PimReportAPI
classes.description: API class for handling PIM report requests, extending the general ReportAPI to include PIM-specific report handling and validation.

methods.name: getReportGeneratorService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of ReportGeneratorService used to determine report features specific to PIM reports.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves and constructs the appropriate report object based on request parameters, throwing an exception if report name is invalid.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving a single report, ensuring report ID is positive and valid for PIM reports.
